title: ONE PROMPT STYLE AT THE SEARCH SIZE
why: His note of v10.52 said the SEARCH prompt was too small, so it went up to the callout size; every other prompt at a place in the world stayed small, each in its own colour and with no plate, so a locked door read smaller than a crate and a prompt over a busy floor was hard to read. Every world prompt (doors, a downed pillager, the rings, the survivor, the seal and the crates) is now drawn one way: at the SEARCH size, on a plate measured to the words, the key in amber brackets, and a short second line where one is needed (Needs the key name under a locked door). Hold prompts read HOLD [E] TO, as the seal, the in-ring call row and the extract verb now do. Words other than the key brackets are unchanged, except LOCKED and the seconds, which lose their spaced hyphen.
now: Every world prompt is drawn at the SEARCH size on a plate, with the key in amber brackets.
